evidence.V1: Front view reads as a lumpy berry bush, but the silhouette and top view are a generic rounded blob with nubs that could equally be a rock or a cake; readable mainly from the front.
evidence.V2: Big mass with 3-4 broad puffs and small gold berries, but no medium tier (no leaf clusters, sub-puffs or twigs) and puff divisions are shallow creases.
evidence.V3: Squat low dome (3.7 x 3.3 x 2.2 studs) with soft lobes; pleasant but the puffs are too shallow to read as confident stylised foliage clumps.
evidence.V4: Foliage is one blobby fused shell with no defined lobe edges, while the berries are visibly low-poly faceted spheres; edge treatment is inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Faint quad-grid lattice across the foliage and bright streaky crease lines where puffs merge on top (puffs close-up, spruce/blossom colourways); berries show polygon facets.
evidence.V6: Flat close-up shows the foliage is a single green value with no light/dark variation; only the gold berries add contrast, so value structure is weak.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material with gold accent berries fits, but the single-value foliage and visible grid shading fall short of the kit's 2-3 value fused-shell look.
evidence.V9: Foliage profile correct: Anchored, CanCollide/CanTouch/CanQuery off, Box fidelity, SmoothPlastic, MeshPart.Color white, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: Quad-grid lattice visible in foliage shading
Bright streaky creases where puffs fuse on the top
top_fixes: Deepen and multiply the puffs (5-7 varied-size clumps with clear undercuts) so the silhouette reads as a bush from all angles
Vertex-colour the foliage in 2-3 values (darker underside/creases, lighter tops)
Clean up normals where puffs merge to remove the streaky creases and grid pattern
Add 2-4 segments to the berries or swap to smoother spheres
